hebrewText: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח יְהוָה֙ מַלְאָ֔ךְ וַ/יַּכְחֵ֞ד כָּל גִּבּ֥וֹר חַ֨יִל֙ וְ/נָגִ֣יד וְ/שָׂ֔ר בְּ/מַחֲנֵ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר וַ/יָּשָׁב֩ בְּ/בֹ֨שֶׁת פָּנִ֜ים לְ/אַרְצ֗/וֹ וַ/יָּבֹא֙ בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהָ֔י/ו ו/מ/יציא/ו וּ/מִֽ/יצִיאֵ֣י מֵעָ֔י/ו שָׁ֖ם הִפִּילֻ֥/הוּ בֶ/חָֽרֶב

tokens.bdb: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring (on the way), cast (away, out), conduct, [idiom] earnestly, forsake, give (up), grow long, lay, leave, let depart (down, go, loose), push away, put (away, forth, in, out), reach forth, send (away, forth, out), set, shoot (forth, out), sow, spread, stretch forth (out).
tokens.explanation: shalach — enviar, mandar, despachar, estender a mão

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
tokens.explanation: YHWH — Nome próprio de Deus revelado a Moisés. Tradição massorética lê "Adonai"

tokens.bdb: a messenger; specifically, of God, i.e. an angel (also a prophet, priest or teacher)
tokens.kjv: ambassador, angel, king, messenger.

tokens.bdb: to secrete, by act or word; hence (intensively) to destroy
tokens.kjv: conceal, cut down (off), desolate, hide.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: powerful; by implication, warrior, tyrant
tokens.kjv: champion, chief, [idiom] excel, giant, man, mighty (man, one), strong (man), valiant man.

tokens.bdb: probably a force, whether of men, means or other resources; an army, wealth, virtue, valor, strength
tokens.kjv: able, activity, ([phrase]) army, band of men (soldiers), company, (great) forces, goods, host, might, power, riches, strength, strong, substance, train, ([phrase]) valiant(-ly), valour, virtuous(-ly), war, worthy(-ily).

tokens.bdb: a commander (as occupying the front), civil, military or religious; generally (abstractly, plural), honorable themes
tokens.kjv: captain, chief, excellent thing, (chief) governor, leader, noble, prince, (chief) ruler.

tokens.bdb: a head person (of any rank or class)
tokens.kjv: captain (that had rule), chief (captain), general, governor, keeper, lord,(-task-)master, prince(-ipal), ruler, steward.

tokens.bdb: an encampment (of travellers or troops); hence, an army, whether literal (of soldiers) or figurative (of dancers, angels, cattle, locusts, stars; or even the sacred courts)
tokens.kjv: army, band, battle, camp, company, drove, host, tents.

tokens.bdb: a king
tokens.kjv: king, royal.
tokens.explanation: melek — rei, governante, soberano de um povo ou nação

tokens.bdb: Ashshur, the second son of Shem; also his descendants and the country occupied by them (i.e. Assyria), its region and its empire
tokens.kjv: Asshur, Assur, Assyria, Assyrians. See H838 (אָשֻׁר).

tokens.bdb: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
tokens.kjv: ((break, build, circumcise, dig, do anything, do evil, feed, lay down, lie down, lodge, make, rejoice, send, take, weep)) [idiom] again, (cause to) answer ([phrase] again), [idiom] in any case (wise), [idiom] at all, averse, bring (again, back, home again), call (to mind), carry again (back), cease, [idiom] certainly, come again (back), [idiom] consider, [phrase] continually, convert, deliver (again), [phrase] deny, draw back, fetch home again, [idiom] fro, get (oneself) (back) again, [idiom] give (again), go again (back, home), (go) out, hinder, let, (see) more, [idiom] needs, be past, [idiom] pay, pervert, pull in again, put (again, up again), recall, recompense, recover, refresh, relieve, render (again), requite, rescue, restore, retrieve, (cause to, make to) return, reverse, reward, [phrase] say nay, send back, set again, slide back, still, [idiom] surely, take back (off), (cause to, make to) turn (again, self again, away, back, back again, backward, from, off), withdraw.

tokens.bdb: shame (the feeling and the condition, as well as its cause); by implication (specifically) an idol
tokens.kjv: ashamed, confusion, [phrase] greatly, (put to) shame(-ful thing).

tokens.bdb: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] accept, a-(be-) fore(-time), against, anger, [idiom] as (long as), at, [phrase] battle, [phrase] because (of), [phrase] beseech, countenance, edge, [phrase] employ, endure, [phrase] enquire, face, favour, fear of, for, forefront(-part), form(-er time, -ward), from, front, heaviness, [idiom] him(-self), [phrase] honourable, [phrase] impudent, [phrase] in, it, look(-eth) (-s), [idiom] me, [phrase] meet, [idiom] more than, mouth, of, off, (of) old (time), [idiom] on, open, [phrase] out of, over against, the partial, person, [phrase] please, presence, propect, was purposed, by reason of, [phrase] regard, right forth, [phrase] serve, [idiom] shewbread, sight, state, straight, [phrase] street, [idiom] thee, [idiom] them(-selves), through ([phrase] -out), till, time(-s) past, (un-) to(-ward), [phrase] upon, upside ([phrase] down), with(-in, [phrase] -stand), [idiom] ye, [idiom] you.
tokens.enLiteralWord: the face ; used in a great variety of applications ; also  as a preposition (before
tokens.explanation: panim — face, presença, frente (sempre plural em hebraico)
tokens.explanationEn: the face ; used in a great variety of applications ; also  as a preposition (before

tokens.bdb: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.
tokens.explanation: eretz — terra, solo, país, região, toda a terra

tokens.bdb: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.
tokens.explanation: bo — vir, ir, entrar, chegar, avançar em direção a algo

tokens.bdb: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
tokens.kjv: court, daughter, door, [phrase] dungeon, family, [phrase] forth of, [idiom] great as would contain, hangings, home(born), (winter) house(-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, [phrase] prison, [phrase] steward, [phrase] tablet, temple, web, [phrase] within(-out).
tokens.enLiteralWord: a house (in the greatest variation of applications
tokens.explanationEn: a house (in the greatest variation of applications

tokens.bdb: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
tokens.kjv: angels, [idiom] exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), [idiom] (very) great, judges, [idiom] mighty.
tokens.enLiteralWord: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
tokens.explanation: Elohim — nome hebraico de Deus. Plural de majestade. Denota o único Deus verdadeiro
tokens.explanationEn: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus

tokens.bdb: issue, i.e. offspring
tokens.kjv: those that came forth.

tokens.bdb: issue, i.e. offspring
tokens.kjv: those that came forth.

tokens.bdb: used only in plural the intestines, or (collectively) the abdomen, figuratively, sympathy; by implication, a vest; by extension the stomach, the uterus (or of men, the seat of generation), the heart (figuratively)
tokens.kjv: belly, bowels, [idiom] heart, womb.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: used only in plural the intestines
tokens.enLiteralWord: used only in plural the intestines
tokens.explanation: used only in plural the intestines
tokens.explanationEn: used only in plural the intestines

tokens.bdb: there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence
tokens.kjv: in it, [phrase] thence, there (-in, [phrase] of, [phrase] out), [phrase] thither, [phrase] whither.

tokens.bdb: to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative)
tokens.kjv: be accepted, cast (down, self, (lots), out), cease, die, divide (by lot), (let) fail, (cause to, let, make, ready to) fall (away, down, -en, -ing), fell(-ing), fugitive, have (inheritance), inferior, be judged (by mistake for H6419 (פָּלַל)), lay (along), (cause to) lie down, light (down), be ([idiom] hast) lost, lying, overthrow, overwhelm, perish, present(-ed, -ing), (make to) rot, slay, smite out, [idiom] surely, throw down.

tokens.bdb: drought; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife, sword, or other sharp implement
tokens.kjv: axe, dagger, knife, mattock, sword, tool.
